# Project Guidelines

## Git Workflow

- For project changes, create and work on a new branch based on `main`; never make changes directly on `main`.
- Name branches `Minh/<short-description>`; do not use `Codex` or `Copilot` in branch names.
- Commit and push work to its `Minh/...` branch, then merge that branch into `main`. Do not push unmerged work directly to `main`.
- Before merging, run the relevant tests and preserve unrelated working-tree changes.
